ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity (white) pixels occupy approximately 75% of the visible surface area, contrasted against low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels primarily located on the perimeter and in linear streaks.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous high-intensity white regions occupy the central lobes. Low-intensity black pigment forms a continuous band along the trailing edge and outer tips. Semi-linear dark striations are distributed across the white field, more densely concentrated near the median notch.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Distinct V-shaped median notch with a pixel-based interior angle of approximately 40 degrees; depth is approximately 15% of the vertical lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern across the entire trailing edge boundary. Significant jagged peaks are visible, particularly on the distal third of the right lobe where the amplitude of the serrations increases.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Geometric transition from a medial concave curve starting at the notch to a lateral convex sweep ending at the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of high-contrast, roughly circular pixel groups (white/light-brown) are localized at the extreme distal tips of both lobes, consistent with barnacle colonization. Smaller, isolated dark focal spots are visible within the central white regions.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Detection of multiple unaligned, dark linear pixel disruptions (rake-like marks) of varying lengths and orientations across the high-intensity ventral surface of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive linear scratching patterns (rake marks) distributed across both ventral lobes and prominent biological encrustations at the distal tips.
other_distinctive_markers: A singular, high-contrast dark circular spot is located in the upper-left quadrant of the left lobe's white ventral region.
